decisions.reason: The query requires an explicit graph-neural-network phrase and a drug-discovery task, giving broad task coverage without relying on the ambiguous GNN acronym.
Both CRISPR-specific technology terminology and an extracellular-vesicle class are mandatory, so the query is inclusive while remaining topically constrained.
The mandatory conjunction between established machine-learning methods and explicit climate-change concepts is suitable for the broad applications topic.
Requiring the exact climate-change phrase plus a risk, vulnerability, impact, threat, or hazard concept appropriately covers the deliberately broad risk topic.
The exact digital-twin phrase is required alongside a healthcare, clinical, patient, or medical context, preventing generic engineering-only retrieval.
The query independently requires plant context, heat stress, and drought or water-deficit stress, matching the combined-stressor topic precisely.
The gene-editing concept is mandatory, and the ALS acronym is protected by disease-specific terminology or recognized ALS-associated genes, addressing its obvious homonym risk.
Microplastics is an unambiguous field term, and under the stated global-mapping rule a single title-and-abstract concept with no geographic restriction is appropriate.
